sentences: Traders moved $522 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-08-10, across 18.5 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 71% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 29%.
The most-traded market was "Will Francesca Hong win the 2026 Wisconsin Governor Democratic primary election?", pulling in $673K of volume.

An unusual reversal: retail traders outperformed bots this week. Active retail earned $20K (+116 bps on volume) while algorithms lost $37K (-13 bps). Weeks like this are rare (bots are typically on top by the execution channel).
